quote: Self inspections should be conducted in order to monitor the implementation and compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice principles and to propose necessary corrective measures.
statement: Carry out self inspections to monitor how Good Manufacturing Practice principles are implemented and complied with, and to propose any necessary corrective measures.

quote: Personnel matters, premises, equipment, documentation, production, quality control, distribution of the medicinal products, arrangements for dealing with complaints and recalls, and self inspection, should be examined at intervals following a pre-arranged programme
statement: Examine personnel matters, premises, equipment, documentation, production, quality control, distribution of medicinal products, complaint and recall arrangements, and self inspection itself at intervals according to a pre-arranged programme, to verify they conform with Quality Assurance principles.

quote: Self inspections should be conducted in an independent and detailed way by designated competent person(s) from the company.
statement: Self inspections are conducted independently and in detail by designated competent person(s) from within the company.

quote: Independent audits by external experts may also be useful.
statement: The company may use independent audits by external experts in addition to self inspections.

quote: All self inspections should be recorded.
statement: Keep a record of every self inspection performed.

quote: Reports should contain all the observations made during the inspections
statement: Self inspection reports should include every observation made during the inspection.

quote: where applicable, proposals for corrective measures
statement: Where applicable, self inspection reports should include proposed corrective measures.

quote: Statements on the actions subsequently taken should also be recorded.
statement: Record statements describing the actions taken afterwards in response to the self inspection.

quote: The self- inspection programme should be designed to detect any shortcomings in the implementation of GMP and to recommend the necessary corrective actions.
statement: Design the self-inspection programme so that it detects shortcomings in GMP implementation and recommends the necessary corrective actions.

quote: Self-inspections should be performed routinely
statement: Carry out self-inspections on a routine basis.

quote: may be, in addition, performed on special occasions, e.g. in the case of product recalls or repeated rejections, or when an inspection by the health authorities is announced
statement: Additional self-inspections may be carried out on special occasions, such as product recalls, repeated rejections, or an announced health authority inspection.

quote: The team responsible for self-inspection should consist of personnel who can evaluate the implementation of GMP objectively.
statement: Staff the self-inspection team with personnel able to assess GMP implementation objectively.

quote: All recommendations for corrective action should be implemented.
statement: Implement every corrective action recommended by self-inspection.

quote: The procedure for self-inspection should be documented
statement: Have a documented self-inspection procedure.

quote: there should be an effective follow-up programme
statement: Maintain an effective follow-up programme for self-inspection findings.

quote: Written instructions for self-inspection should be established to provide a minimum and uniform standard of requirements.
statement: Establish written self-inspection instructions that set a minimum, uniform standard of requirements.

quote: These may include questionnaires on GMP requirements covering at least the following items:
statement: Self-inspection instructions may include GMP questionnaires that cover at least: personnel; premises including personnel facilities; maintenance of buildings and equipment; storage of starting materials and finished products; equipment; production and in-process controls; QC; documentation; sanitation and hygiene; validation and revalidation programmes; calibration of instruments or measurement systems; recall procedures; complaints management; labels control; and results of previous self-inspections with any corrective steps taken.

quote: Management should appoint a self-inspection team consisting of experts in their respective fields who are familiar with GMP.
statement: Management should appoint a self-inspection team made up of experts in their own fields who are familiar with GMP.

quote: The members of the team may be appointed from inside or outside the company.
statement: Self-inspection team members may be appointed from within the company or from outside it.

quote: should preferably be at least once a year
statement: Self-inspections should be conducted at least once a year (the frequency may otherwise depend on company requirements).

quote: The frequency should be stated in the procedure.
statement: The self-inspection procedure should state how often self-inspections are carried out.

quote: A report should be made at the completion of a self-inspection.
statement: Prepare a report when each self-inspection is completed.

quote: The report should include: (a) self-inspection results; (b) evaluation and conclusions; (c) recommended corrective actions.
statement: The self-inspection report should include the results of the self-inspection, an evaluation and conclusions, and the recommended corrective actions.

quote: There should be an effective follow-up programme.
statement: Maintain an effective programme for following up on self-inspection findings.

quote: The company management should evaluate both the self-inspection report and the corrective actions as necessary.
statement: Company management evaluates the self-inspection report and, as necessary, the corrective actions.

quote: It may be useful to supplement self-inspections with a quality audit.
statement: The site may add quality audits to its self-inspection programme.

quote: Such audits may also be extended to suppliers and contractors
statement: The site may extend quality audits to cover its suppliers and contractors.

quote: The person responsible for QC should have responsibility, together with other relevant departments, for approving suppliers who can reliably supply starting and packaging materials that meet established specifications.
statement: The person responsible for quality control, jointly with other relevant departments, is responsible for approving suppliers that can reliably provide starting and packaging materials meeting established specifications.

quote: Before suppliers are approved and included in the approved suppliers’ list or specifications, they should be evaluated.
statement: Suppliers are evaluated before being approved and added to the approved suppliers' list or specifications.

quote: The evaluation should take into account a supplier’s history and the nature of the materials to be supplied.
statement: Supplier evaluation considers the supplier's history and the nature of the materials they will supply.

quote: If an audit is required, it should determine the supplier’s ability to conform with GMP standards.
statement: Where a supplier audit is required, the audit determines whether the supplier is able to comply with GMP standards.

quote: The self-inspection programme shall be designed to detect any shortcomings in the implementation of good manufacturing practices and to recommend the necessary corrective actions.
statement: Design the self-inspection programme so that it detects shortcomings in GMP implementation and recommends the necessary corrective actions.

quote: Self-inspections shall be performed routinely
statement: Carry out self-inspections on a routine basis.

quote: may be, in addition, performed on special occasions e.g., in the case of product recall or repeated rejections, or when an inspection by the regulatory authorities is announced
statement: Additional self-inspections may be carried out on special occasions, such as a product recall, repeated rejections, or an announced regulatory inspection.

quote: The team responsible for self-inspection shall consist of personnel who can evaluate the implementation of good manufacturing practices objectively.
statement: Staff the self-inspection team with personnel able to assess GMP implementation objectively.

quote: All recommendations for corrective action shall be implemented.
statement: Implement every corrective action recommended from self-inspection.

quote: The procedure for self-inspection shall be documented
statement: Maintain a documented self-inspection procedure.

quote: there shall be an effective follow-up programme
statement: Operate an effective follow-up programme for self-inspection findings.

quote: Written instructions for self-inspection shall be established to provide a minimum and uniform standard of requirements
statement: The site must have written self-inspection instructions that set a minimum, uniform standard of requirements.

quote: These may include questionnaires on good manufacturing practices requirements covering at least the following items, namely:- (a) personnel; (b) premises including personnel facilities; (c) maintenance of buildings and equipment; (d) storage of starting materials and finished products; (e) equipment; (f) production and in-process controls; (g) quality control (QC); (h) documentation; (i) sanitation and hygiene; (j) validation and revalidation programmes; (k) calibration of instruments or measurement systems; (l) recall procedures; (m) complaints management; (n) labels control; and (o) results of previous self-inspections and any corrective steps taken.
statement: The self-inspection instructions may include GMP questionnaires. If used, they cover at least: personnel; premises including personnel facilities; maintenance of buildings and equipment; storage of starting materials and finished products; equipment; production and in-process controls; quality control; documentation; sanitation and hygiene; validation and revalidation programmes; calibration of instruments or measurement systems; recall procedures; complaints management; labels control; and results of previous self-inspections and any corrective steps taken.

quote: Management shall appoint a self-inspection team consisting of experts in their respective fields who are familiar with GMP.
statement: Management must appoint a self-inspection team made up of experts in their respective fields who are familiar with GMP.

quote: The members of the team may be appointed from inside or outside the company.
statement: Self-inspection team members may be drawn from within the company or from outside it.

quote: The frequency with which self-inspections are conducted may depend on company requirements but shall be at least once in a year.
statement: Self-inspections must be conducted at least once a year; the frequency may otherwise be set according to company requirements.

statement: Ensure each self-inspection report contains the results of the self-inspection, an evaluation with conclusions, and the recommended corrective actions.

quote: There shall be an effective follow-up programme.
statement: An effective follow-up programme for self-inspections must be in place.

quote: The company management shall evaluate both the self-inspection report and the corrective actions as necessary.
statement: Company management must evaluate the self-inspection report and the corrective actions, as necessary.

quote: It may be useful to supplement self-inspections with a quality audit.
statement: The site may supplement its self-inspections with a quality audit that examines and assesses all or part of the quality system in order to improve it.

quote: Such audits may also be extended to suppliers and contractors.
statement: The site may extend quality audits to its suppliers and contractors.

statement: The person responsible for quality control, jointly with other relevant departments, must be responsible for approving suppliers able to reliably supply starting and packaging materials that meet established specifications.

statement: Suppliers must be evaluated before they are approved and added to the approved suppliers' list or specifications.

quote: The evaluation shall take into account a supplier’s history and the nature of the materials to be supplied.
statement: Supplier evaluation must consider the supplier's history and the nature of the materials it will supply.

quote: If an audit is required, it shall determine the supplier’s ability to conform with good manufacturing practices standards.
statement: Where a supplier audit is required, the audit must determine whether the supplier is able to conform with GMP standards.

quote: regular internal audits should be performed in accordance with an approved schedule
statement: Perform internal audits on a regular basis, following an approved schedule, to verify compliance with GMP principles for APIs.

quote: Audit findings and corrective actions should be documented
statement: Document the findings of audits and the corrective actions arising from them.

quote: brought to the attention of responsible management of the firm
statement: Report audit findings and corrective actions to the firm's responsible management.

quote: Agreed corrective actions should be completed in a timely and effective manner.
statement: Complete agreed corrective actions in a timely and effective way.
